name: No Orc Left Behind
summary: You are sent into Alcaz Prison to find Commander Folkar and learn what is happening below the keep. An army waits in the dungeons, and you are warned not to go alone.

sections.title: Below the Keep
sections.body: Commander Folkar is somewhere in the dungeons beneath the keep, and you are sent into Alcaz Prison to find him. If he is alive, you are to free him and learn what is happening there. An army waits below, so you are warned that you will need allies to survive.

sections.title: The Search
sections.body: Ulka sent you to find Commander Folkar after surviving a deadly encounter. Folkar praises her service to the Kor’kron and says he will see that she receives a field promotion. Yet he says the mission is not complete, and you cannot leave Alcaz Prison.

faq.answer: You are sent into Alcaz Prison, in the dungeons beneath the keep.
You are looking for Commander Folkar in Alcaz Prison.

faq.q: What am I supposed to learn?
faq.answer: You are asked to learn what is happening in the dungeons beneath the keep.

faq.q: Why am I warned to bring allies?
faq.answer: An army waits in the dungeons, and you are warned that you will not survive there alone.

attribution: In-game quest text: No Orc Left Behind
